note: Every model runtime or model endpoint SCCE may use must be declared here with the config gate that enables it. Undeclared ones remain forbidden (tools/no-hidden-model-check.mjs). Declared != enabled: each is off unless its gate is set in scce.config.json.

packages.name: @huggingface/transformers
packages.purpose: Local ONNX runtime for the constrained-decoding realization candidate (Phase 2) and local embeddings (Phase 3).
packages.network: Model files are fetched only by an explicit `scce model download`; inference never calls out.

models.purpose: Constrained-decoding wording realizer (Phase 2). Qwen3-4B selectable via realization.constrainedDecoding.modelId.
Visual evidence embeddings (Phase 3): image/PDF-page vectors stored as attributes on evidence spans; text-side query embedding for the late-interaction prefilter.
